$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFSP (AIP France, chart dated 2025-01-23): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Pontarlier

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Unpaved RWY reserved for home-based ACFT and ULM.
Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
Snow covered AD during winter period.
Contact ACB for more information.
Particular attention is requested from the pilots due to the proximity of Pontarlier hospital heliport, whose North funnels (axis 320° / 140°) interfere with circuit patterns and takeoffs RWY 02.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Use intermediate holding point N to use RWY 02.
Use intermediate holding point S to use RWY 20.
Traffic patterns training reserved for home-based ACFT.
Low-height circuit patterns only with instructor on board.
Preferred QFU 019°, due to noise pollution and clearing.
Avoid to fly over villages of Vuillecin, Houtaud, Dommartin, les Granges Narboz.
AEM (NR 8054) on AD: 500 ASFC, SR-SS.
As per protocol.
Piste non revêtue réservée aux ACFT basés et aux ULM.
Utilisation simultanée des pistes interdite.
AD enneigé en période hivernale.
Se renseigner auprès de l'ACB.

Une attention particulière est demandée aux pilotes due à la proximité de l'hélistation de l'hôpital de Pontarlier, dont les trouées Nord (axe 320° / 140°) interfèrent avec les tours de piste 20 et les décollages en piste 02.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Utiliser le point d'attente intermédiaire N pour utilisation de la piste 02.
Utiliser le point d'attente intermédiaire S pour utilisation de la piste 20.
Entraînement en tours de piste réservés aux ACFT basés.
Circuits basse hauteur : autorisés avec instructeur à bord.
QFU 019° préférentiel cause nuisances sonores et dégagements.
Éviter le survol des villages de Vuillecin, Houtaud, Dommartin, les Granges Narboz.
AEM (N° 8054) sur AD : 500 ASFC, SR-SS.
Selon protocole.
